english.note: This is the all-purpose possessive form for saying something belongs to him without a following noun.

exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 bun2 syu1 hai6 keoi5 ge3

english.note: This is the all-purpose standalone possessive for something belonging to it, as in 「呢個係佢嘅」.

exampleSentences.english: That cat has left; this cage is its.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰隻貓走咗，呢個籠係佢嘅。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 zek3 maau1 zau2 zo2 ni1 go3 lung4 hai6 keoi5 ge3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something belonging to her when the owned noun is omitted.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 keoi5 ge3
